provider.name: PixelLab
provider.note: Animates the ALREADY-ACCEPTED character by id, so identity is preserved by construction rather than re-prompted. This is why the walk frames match the accepted idle without any identity work.

whyTwoTemplates: The 'walk' template systematically flips the head on the SOUTH direction: 1-2 of 6 frames render the back of the head mid-cycle. Two seeds reproduced it. The separate 'walking' template holds the south heading cleanly. north/west/east keep 'walk' because it is clean there and regenerating risks a regression - a 'walking' north was generated and REJECTED for rendering the chest gem on the character's back.

reproducibility.note: Normalization is deterministic. Generation is a hosted third-party service; seeds are recorded but identical regeneration is not verified. The committed frames are the authority.
